content.text:
I added both features to `index.html`. The script's syntax checks out, but I haven't tested it in a browser.

- **Editing:** double-click a todo's text to get an edit field (`todo-edit-input`). Enter or clicking away saves; Escape cancels. The todo stays in the same spot in the list.
- **Search:** typing in the `search-input` box shows only todos whose text contains the term, ignoring case. It works on top of the All/Active/Completed filter.

Rejected: deleting a todo when you save it blank. A blank save now keeps the old text instead. I also put the search box outside the add form, so pressing Enter in it doesn't add a todo.
